title: Mixed Event — Warmth in Every Stitch — Episode4 What Comes to Mind

meta.Event Outline: Shizuku feels grateful for all of Mafuyu's help with studying and club activities, and wants to do something in return. When she learns that Mafuyu is looking for ways to improve her home ec project, she offers some embroidery lessons.

rows.Line: A few days later
Cafe

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Alright, let's get “Operation: Embroidery Gifts” underway!

rows.Speaker: Haruka, Shizuku & Mafuyu
rows.Line: Yeah!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Today, we'll be choosing our embroidery designs.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Let's begin by jotting down ideas in our notebooks.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Roger!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: What should we keep in mind as we come up with our designs?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Good question...
If you make your design too complicated, then actually embroidering it won't be easy. So, I recommend keeping things simple.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Also, you'll need to transfer the design in your notebook over to your fabric, so you'll need to get the size right.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: For example, for your makeup pouches, Haruka, I recommend going with slightly larger designs since you have quite a lot of space available.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: As for you, Asahina, I recommend smaller designs for the corners of your handkerchiefs.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
I see...
In other words, you need to think about what the finished product is going to look like.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes. I even brought along books about embroidering accessories, so you can see how big their designs are.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Anyway, let's do our best to come up with designs that everybody is going to love.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Yeah!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (Designs that everybody is going to love...)
Several dozen minutes later

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Oh, are you making a flower? It's so cute!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Thanks. This is for Minori's pouch...
I'm thinking about making a whole flower field.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe. That's just perfect for Minori's personality.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: As for me, I'm thinking about making her an embroidered keychain of Samo.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Oh, she'll definitely love that.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Do you know what you'd like to do, Asahina?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
No, not yet...
I've never designed anything like this before, so I'm finding it a little challenging.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: That's perfectly understandable. I'm no expert either, so I also become stuck for ideas sometimes.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: But I do find it helpful to think about what your recipient likes or enjoys.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: What they like or enjoy...?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Hmm... For example, in Kanade's case, would that be music? Although, her relationship with it is a bit complicated.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Yes, she does take her music very seriously.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: In that case, what if you included some musical notes and symbols in your design?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
But just musical notes might look a bit sterile.
What else does Kanade like? Instant noodles, I guess...?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Yes, but...
Actually embroidering that may prove difficult.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yeah, I'm not sure instant noodles are the best choice...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Haha. You're probably right...
Coming up with a good embroidery design for Kanade that's gonna look good is really hard.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Oh... What if you thought about Kanade's personality instead?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Her personality?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yes. I decided to embroider a flower field based on who Minori is as a person.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Flowers are even a part of her last name. And just like real flowers, Minori Hanasato has a talent for making others smile.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I see. Which is how you arrived on your design...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Who Kanade is as a person...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: What is your perception of her, Asahina?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Does having her around make you happy or feel at ease? That may be a good place to start.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Right...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I don't know if this is the right answer...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: But I feel this warmth whenever I'm with her or listen to one of her songs.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Yeah, I totally know what you mean!
She's also been a huge source of support for me.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I see. She sounds like a wonderful person.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: She is! Kanade's songs are like these rays of light poking through the darkness... They always hit me really hard when I listen to them.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: They have a way of getting you to look up and move forward...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (Rays of light poking through the darkness...)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: You're right.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Kanade...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: She's always there to help whenever I get stuck...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: She's the person that's always there to tell me that everything is going to be okay. That we can move forward together.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I think that's who Kanade is to me.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I'm sorry. I know that sounds very abstract.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Not at all.
I think I have a much better understand of what Yoisaki represents in your mind.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (A light that guides the way when you find yourself stumbling around in the dark...)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (A design which embodies that warmth would be...)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: How about a candle...?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: A candle...?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, because candles can aid you by illuminating darkened paths, right?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Also, having even just a small light can be a source of encouragement when you find yourself stuck in the dark. Is that close in feeling, maybe?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Oh, I'm sorry if I'm wrong...
That was what immediately came to mind for me, that's all...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
No, you aren't wrong...
Somehow, it fits perfectly.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Yeah, that's also sorta how I see Kanade!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Really? Thank goodness...!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Then, I'll work on my design using what you and the others just said.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Thank you for your help.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: You're welcome. And please feel free to ask again if you need my help.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Okay.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Phew... I think we're all set with our designs now.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yes. Also, thanks to Shizuku, we know which stitches and techniques we'll each be using. Now we just need to start gathering materials.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Okay, let's do our best to make sure that our gifts turn out really amazing!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku, Mafuyu & Haruka
rows.Line:
Yes!
Yeah!
